scope: School inventory membership check and internal roster integrity
reference_inventory: 2026 NCAA Division I FBS football institutions inventory
qualifications: The 138-school set matches the published 2026 FBS inventory after normalizing common abbreviations (App State/Appalachian State, UNC/North Carolina, FAU/Florida Atlantic, USF/South Florida, FIU/Florida International, ULM/Louisiana-Monroe, and common Miami naming).
The NCAA's September 2026 membership breakdown lists 136 active FBS members and two programs transitioning from FCS to FBS.
North Dakota State is included in the Mountain West's official 2026 football membership; Sacramento State is included as a football-only member of the MAC for 2026.
The custom 12-conference alignment is separate from real-world 2026 conference affiliation and remains a project configuration.
